subject: Cultural, Arts, and Recreation Transition Team Report
overview: The Cultural, Arts, and Recreation Transition Team presented a roadmap for enhancing city programming and facilities based on public surveys and focus groups. Mayor Burke committed to implementing the report's recommendations, including pursuing library grants and streamlining public art initiatives.

items.title: Introduction of Transition Team members
items.summary: Mayor Burke introduced the members of the Cultural, Arts, and Recreation Transition Team and announced the appointment of Allie Fiske as the city's liaison to businesses and the cultural community.

items.title: Presentation of Transition Team findings and report
items.summary: Chair Ken Krause presented a report identifying 12 priority focus areas for the city, recommending strategic staffing increases, facility investment, and the pursuit of new revenue sources like the Massachusetts Cultural Facilities Fund.

items.title: Mayor's implementation plan and library updates
items.summary: The Mayor announced the formation of recreation focus groups and confirmed the city is pursuing state grants to expand the library into a multi-use public meeting and maker space.

items.title: Role of the Business and Cultural Liaison
items.summary: Allie Fiske detailed how her role will facilitate communication between the city and cultural organizations while partnering with the Medford Arts Council to simplify the process for public art projects.
